nodes.label: Game servers
nodes.text: Match clients and the game's live data API. Everything on air starts here: gameplay video and the numbers behind it.

nodes.label: Observers
nodes.text: Observer stations follow the fight, not the map. They cut between in-game cameras so the audience never misses the play.

nodes.label: Switcher / PGM
nodes.text: The control room mixes observer feeds, cameras, replay and casters into one programme output.

nodes.label: Graphics + data
nodes.text: Scorebugs, drafts and stat panels are keyed over programme, filled automatically from live game API data.

nodes.label: AOBS Cloud
nodes.text: Our cloud production platform encodes and routes the finished programme, so crew can run a show from anywhere.

nodes.label: Backup Streamer
nodes.text: A second path stays hot. If the primary signal drops, the backup takes over and the stream stays live.

nodes.label: Twitch · YouTube · Kick
nodes.text: One programme, delivered to every platform your audience watches on.
